name: Plasmas Concepts for Energy Applications
description: Introduction: Role of plasma in energy and environment applications; Different types of plasmas; Basic concepts for plasma science and technology; Concept of plasma potential and its importance in design of plasma sources, Pre-sheath, Plasma sheath-Wall interaction; Different Types of Plasma Sources; Basic Plasma diagnostics; Plasma as Fluids; Design of a basic plasma discharge system; Plasma Fusion Energy; Plasma-based processing for energy materials; Plasma for environment pollution mitigation; Plasmas for waste management; Other applications of plasmas as energy-efficient and environment-friendly solutions
